purpose: Private fictional football scouting model for the 251 standard-form Pokémon. Numeric grades and letter tiers are never rendered in game UI. JavaScript is delivered to browsers, so this is presentation-hidden game data, not a security secret.
physicalSource: The bundled dist/assets/pokemon.js catalog supplies standard-form heightMeters and weightKg from the sourced species data, and the existing hand-estimated fortySeconds value. Scouting traits below are editorial game judgments, not official Pokémon statistics.

model.traits: Individually reviewed possession control, field awareness, functional lore strength, contact durability, football turf/flight mobility, passing accuracy, and anatomy-specific QB ceiling. Each species has explicit values; no default species profile is used.
model.possession: Ball possession can use functional hands, psychic control, tentacles, a mouth carry or talon catch. Forward passing additionally needs a plausible accurate release. Independent quarterback ceilings prevent secure mouth/talon carriers becoming good passers. Center is capped at C-tier (59) for species with severe arm/release limitations, or F-tier (35) when they also lack basic possession control; carrying with a mouth is distinct from a reliable snap.
model.speed: 100 * exp(-(fortySeconds - 2.65) / 5.1), clamped 0–100. Actual football movement blends this 30% with reviewed species mobility 70%.
model.frame: Mass = clamp(45 + log2(weightKg / 18) * 15). Reach = clamp(heightMeters * 45). Frame = 70% mass + 30% reach. Power uses 86% reviewed strength and 14% frame. Contact uses 92% reviewed durability and 8% mass.
model.quarterback: 26% possession control, 27% awareness, 25% accuracy, 12% functional power, 5% movement, 5% reach; capped by individually reviewed throwing anatomy. Cocoons, burrowers, ordinary armless fish, spheres and most quadrupeds are F-tier.
model.roleWeights: See named pure formulas in dist/ratings.js. Guards/nose tackles emphasize power, contact and frame; tackles and edge rushers add footwork; centers emphasize snaps; receivers emphasize control, speed and reach; linebackers combine pursuit, tackling and recognition; safeties emphasize awareness; corners emphasize coverage movement.
model.footwork: Trench grades multiply by 0.65 + 0.35 * min(1, mobility / 45), so armor and mass alone cannot make static aquatic bodies/cocoons elite blockers. Open-field roles multiply by 0.55 + 0.45 * min(1, mobility / 50).
model.supernaturalBalance: Established psychic/ghost manipulation supplies functional control where explicitly noted. Intangibility, hypnosis, time travel, poison and elemental attacks do not auto-win snaps or injure players. Ditto receives an adaptable baseline rather than copying a drafted or opposing star.
model.symmetry: Left/right tackles and guards use equal formulas. MLB/ILB share inside-linebacker grades. WLB, SLB, NB and DB are explicit blends of the appropriate football responsibilities.
model.limits: No actual training, NFL outcome or official speed/athleticism measurement is claimed. This is a deliberately simple fictional game model, with scores reflecting standard forms and ordinary role responsibilities.
